'''Barit Chavana''' is an acrobat in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|traveling show]].

==Appearance==
He is short and compact. He has dark skin and [[Sea Folk]] tattoos on his hands.

==History==
He is one of four "[[Chavana|brothers]]" who travels with Valan Luca's Traveling Show. They are obviously not brothers, due to the differences of their nationalities.

==Activities==
He is introduced to [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]] and [[Juilin Sandar]] by Valan Luca when the four join the show. When Nynaeve invites the brothers to dinner, they all begin to flirt with her, causing a fight between Nynaeve and [[Latelle Luca|Latelle]].<ref>{{5|24}}</ref> They are still with the show when [[Matrim Cauthon]] comes to the show.<ref>{{10|29}}</ref>
